statement: Community DS4 summary describes signed 16-bit IMU groups and 1920×942 touch coordinate convention; Linux parses calibration from separate transport-dependent feature reports and exposes motion normalized through bias/sensitivity coefficients.

applicability.revision: research revisions: Linux 4056b3c, historical Linux v6.1 830b3c6, SDL 535d80b, OpenPuck 29f4d1e, community 290e4a2; retail revision unknown
applicability.scope: Community playstation.md 31–42; hid-playstation.c 468–505, 2006–2116. Units/mapping differ between raw packet, kernel evdev and SDL consumer.
